label: <DEL> step of long sequences that start with m (about to output first token m)
explanation: Fires almost only at the delimiter step (96% of mass); never fires in the copy phase and only weakly at the last 1-2 original tokens of long sequences. Within the delimiter, it is graded by two things: sequence length (rises sharply with L; nearly silent for L<=6, strongest at L=8-9) and identity of the first original token, which is the token about to be output: m dominates (64% of mass, 25x lift), then i, x, h, with weaker activations for other first tokens. Top activations are delimiters of length 7-9 sequences beginning with m (often m m ...). The predicate L>=7 & first token m gives about 80% precision but misses the long tail of weak activations on other first tokens; adding i/x/h raises mass recall to about 0.80 at lower precision. Does not depend on digit count or copy correctness.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=m (+8.74), orig1=m (+3.76), orig0=i (+3.70), orig0=x (+3.64), orig0=h (+2.99), to_go=1 (+2.97). Lower it: phase=2 (-9.06), next_out=- (-5.27), orig5=- (-5.00), orig0=f (-3.87).
